IS: 9412 (Part I) -1980 




Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

x SPECIFICATION FOR 
MALE STUD ELBOW BODY FOR OIL-HYDRAULIC 

COUPLINGS 

PART I MADE FROM FORGINGS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for male stud elbow body 
made from forgings with parallel pipe threads for use in oil-hydraulic systems. ( 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Material — Steel conforming to Class 1A of IS : 1875 - 1978 ( Specification for carbon steel billets* 
blooms, slabs and bars for forgings {fourth revision) y or any other steel as agreed to between the 
user and the manufacturer, 

4. Surface Protection — Elbow bodies shall be phosphated according to Class A2 of IS : 3618- 
1966 'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel -for protection against corrosion*, 
unless otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These elbow bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type B of IS: 9411 -1980 
1 Specification for elbow coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems '. 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 ( Part I ) - 1978 
1 General requirements for ferrule-type couplings used in oil-hydrulic systems: Part I General \ 

% Designation-- A male stud elbow body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 22 mm and 
conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Stud Elbow Body L22 IS : 9412 ( Part I ) 



EXPLANATORY N OTE 

This standard covers elbow bodies made from forgings only. The 6lbow bodies made from 
bar stock are covered in IS : 9412 (Part II )-1980 ' Specification for male Stud elbow body for oil- 
hydraulic couplings: Part II Made from bar stock '. 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following 
standards: 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes : 
Part 1 : 1972 Heavy series ( metric ), and 
Part 3 : 1974 Light series ( metric ). British Standards Instituti6n ( BSl ). 

DIN 3904 - 1965 Ncn-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions, elbow used as an adaptor with 
paraUel thread on screwed-in end for use with union nut. Deutsches Instltut fur 
Normurig (DIN ).
